name: surveillance_dataset_manifest
description: Publicly accessible multi-camera person-tracking datasets suitable for an investigation demo. These videos are not bundled in the repository and must be downloaded manually according to the source licensing terms.

preferredSources.license: Review the PETS 2009 terms of use before redistribution or commercial reuse.
preferredSources.notes: Good for synchronized multi-camera tracking and cross-view person association.

preferredSources.license: Check the official EPFL dataset notice and licensing conditions before use.
preferredSources.notes: Useful for benchmarking Re-ID and camera transitions.

importInstructions: 1. Download a small subset from an official dataset page or authorized mirror.
2. Keep videos outside the frontend source bundle (for example under data/datasets/<dataset>/<camera-id>/).
3. Add a per-camera metadata entry with camera id, source URL, acquisition timestamp, and any ground-truth identity mapping.
4. Do not claim cross-camera identity matches unless the dataset supports them or the Re-ID model was run on the imported footage.
